summary: The prepared main already contains the stable-public-API rewrite from merged upstream PR #36349. The historical issue revision reproduces the reported FlyDSL 0.3.2 import failure, while the current wheel-only import succeeds and all 22 registered numerical and boundary regressions pass on the assigned gfx950 GPU. No duplicate source change was justified.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction using the exact fused_residual_norm.py from issue revision 2573190b9377debd135417f25b0c4185b0a3c48a; failed with the reported missing flydsl.expr.buffer_ops ImportError before GPU execution.
Passing-after import of the current replacement from the installed FlyDSL 0.3.2 wheel; reported minimum aligned dimension 5120.

All 22 registered tests passed on one gfx950. GPU results were compared with independent fp32 PyTorch references across norm kinds, fused/non-fused paths, gate and affine specializations, broadcast/per-row/4D layouts, D=10240 multi-tile execution, cache reuse, and wheel-only import.
Empty diff confirms the current implementation and regression file exactly match merged fix PR #36349's merge commit.

gpu_execution.evidence: 22/22 registered tests passed on the sole visible AMD Instinct MI350X, gcnArchName gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, using ROCm 7.2 and FlyDSL 0.3.2; see evidence/full-gpu-tests.log and evidence/environment.log.

remaining_limitations: No diffusion model weights were available or required, so no full model/server or semantic-quality run was performed.
Validation used one assigned gfx950 GPU only; gfx942 and multi-GPU behavior were not tested.
The historical kernel cannot reach numerical GPU execution with FlyDSL 0.3.2 because the reproduced import failure occurs first.
No native C++ source was changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
